versions.changelog:
- Automatically generates high-quality conventional commit messages by analyzing staged Git changes.
- Detects change type (feat, fix, docs, etc.), scope, and breaking changes.
- Outputs properly formatted messages following the Conventional Commits specification.
- Saves time and improves the quality/consistency of commit messages.
- Enables automation for changelogs, semantic versioning, and CI/CD triggers.
- Provides customization options for commit style, scope, and issue linking."
